title: Bazar Disday Rahay Shaam Neray Aondi Rahi
body:
Kadam Kadam Tay Ridawan, Di Aas Jaandi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad Tenu Bachawan’ch, Chadaraan Lagiyaan
Meri Sakina De Kanaan Di, Baaliyan Lagiyan
Beemar Laal Nu Ay Aa-n Ke Jagaandi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Na Kidray Shaam e Ghariban Day, Maaray Mar Jaawun
Ay Soch Rondi Si Zainab, Na Baal Dar Jawan
Safeen Ghazi Di Safraan, De Vich Sunaandi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Aseer Baawan Ne Waalan Ne, Chehra Kajjeya Ay
Ajeeb Haal’ch Waakif, Bhira Da Milleya Ay
Oh Apne Aap Nu Mukhtaar Ton Chupaandi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Faraz Hussain Tay Abbas, De Nibhaaye Ne
Dittay Ne Phehray Onay Khut-bay Vi Sunaye Ne
Bhira Nu Rondi Tay Abid, Nu Vi Bachaandi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Oh Shaam Rahwan De Jis Shehr, Vich Vi Jaanday Sarn
Ay Kalmagoan Di Basti Ay, Jaan Lenday Sarn
Jadon Vi Pathran Di Barish, Siraan Tay Aandi Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
Madinay Waaleya Zahra Da, Maan Na Rakhheya
Ay Shaam Walay Kevain Maan, Rakhday Zainab Da
Ay Oh Paishi Si Akbar, Jo Dhi Nibhaandi Rahi
